contract: Deterministically bind evaluated source commit, source tree, mobile release manifest and verified Android/iOS source artifacts into RELEASE_GATE_CLOSURE.json.
regression_contracts: fingerprint changes when a bound artifact hash changes
attestation is persisted into closure evidence
artifact integrity FAIL cannot receive PASS provenance
security_boundary: Integrity fingerprint only; not a digital signature or trusted-builder attestation. Real browser, microphone, storage, Android-device and iPhone-device gates remain authoritative.
